classifierProblem: The incumbent uses independent BCE cells, so every absent label is trained as a hard negative even when selective 0-2 annotation only establishes that a label was not selected. This can entrench common-label priors and suppress semantically plausible rare labels.
hypothesis: Preserving a pretrained NLI sentence-pair head and training Event-to-label-definition pairs with selected labels as entailment and sampled absent labels as neutral can learn explicit Product-18 semantics without treating annotation absence as contradiction. This should broaden short-Event label behavior while keeping precision defensible.
differenceFromHistoricalNliDeberta: The rejected historical experiment discarded the NLI head and attached a new 21-label head. This experiment preserves the original contradiction/entailment/neutral head and performs one pairwise semantic judgment per Product-18 label.

trainingData.rights: HISTORICAL_UNRESOLVED_RESEARCH_LINEAGE_ONLY; no new production or redistribution clearance claimed
trainingData.sourceIsolation: existing sourceGroup disjointness against COSO-149 must pass

pairConstruction.positive: every selected Product-18 label becomes an entailment pair
pairConstruction.absent: exactly three deterministic absent Product-18 labels per row become neutral pairs
pairConstruction.contradictionTargets: none added; label absence is not asserted to contradict the Event
pairConstruction.hypotheses: fixed canonical Product-18 definitions phrased as the writer's secondary emotion
pairConstruction.selectionInputs: training row ID and seed 48 only; no model output, COSO error, RTN result, or desired label count

training.loss: unweighted three-class cross entropy using the preserved NLI head
training.checkpointSelection: single final checkpoint; no interim COSO/RTN evaluation and no sweep

inference.score: softmax entailment probability for each of 18 fixed Event/hypothesis pairs
inference.selector: unchanged global threshold 0.35, probability-descending fixed-order tie-break, maximum two labels

successCriteria.RTNResolved: micro-F1 >=0.3313265306; macro-F1 >=0.3184047525; exact-set >=50.41%; FP<=64; FN<=85; summed absolute 0/1/2 count error<=54
successCriteria.COSO149: micro-F1>=0.5180528053; macro-F1>=0.3351786297; FP<=60; FN<=87; no support>=5 label loses >0.08 F1
successCriteria.decision: RETAIN_FOR_RESEARCH only if every gate passes; otherwise REJECT

forbidden: RTN training, calibration, sample, hypothesis, checkpoint, threshold, or intervention selection
learning-rate, seed, epoch, or loss sweep
